name: rank-slope
title: Rank Slope
description: Two-context slopegraph with a shared linear scale, per-item color, and deterministically de-collided endpoint labels.

meta.question: How does the ranking reorder between two contexts?
meta.whenToUse: Re-ranking between exactly two contexts (two benchmarks, two dates, before/after) where crossings and spread change are the message.
meta.antiUse: More than two contexts — use lines; when only the gap per item matters — use dumbbell-range.
